definitions: A visual development tool used to automate business processes and create guided experiences within a platform, often involving drag-and-drop functionality to define logic and actions.
A feature within certain software applications (e.g., Salesforce) that allows users to design, build, and manage automated workflows and processes without writing code.
examples: The consultant used Flow Builder to automate the lead assignment process.
Learning Flow Builder is essential for Salesforce administrators.
Complex business logic can be implemented with Flow Builder.
